messages:
Maria P: Quick sync — want to finalize the UX for the error request accordion + export CTA before dev kickoff tomorrow. Low friction please. Josh D: Sketch attached in Figma, but TL;DR: accordion per request (header shows status + short id), expand reveals timeline + stacktrace + metadata. Export/Download as a tertiary action in header, and a global export in the top bar for bulk. Sam K: Performance note: lazy-render expanded panels (hydrate on expand) — otherwise long traces kill the render. Also we need keyboard focus to land inside the panel when expanded. Nora A11y: +1 to focus trap on expand. Also aria-expanded must be present on the header button, and the expanded container needs role="region" with an accessible name. Example: ```
...
``` Nora A11y: For correlation IDs: don't render as plain text. Make them a copy button with aria-label="Copy correlation ID" so screen readers get the affordance. Lily QA: Test cases: expand/collapse via keyboard, shift+tab back to header, copy corrID, download includes corrID in filename (e.g., redwood-trace-12345.json). Also ensure export respects current filter (time range). Maria P: Copy question — should the per-request action say "Download trace" or "Export snapshot"? We want clear intent for non-technical folks. Josh D: "Download trace (JSON)" is explicit. "Export snapshot" sounds vague. Short is better on small headers. Sam K: Dev ops friendly: implement an endpoint that returns a stable JSON + metadata. Frontend just triggers `GET /traces/{id}?format=json` and streams file. No heavy client-side construction. ci-bot: Build queued for feature/export-trace (branch: feat/trace-download) — test artifact will include sample trace JSON. Nora A11y: Small a11y nit: when the panel expands, announce "Trace details expanded for request 12345" using live region (polite). Avoid generic announcements. Maria P: Sounds like consensus: per-request header button "Download trace (JSON)" + copy corrID button, focus moves into panel, aria roles as Nora suggested, and a global bulk export in top bar for CSV/JSON of selected requests. Sam to scope endpoint. Josh to update Figma with compact header copy and iconography. Lily to add QA checklist. I'll collect follow-ups in the PR description. :thumbsup:
